header.title: Services
header.subtitle: AI agent and generative AI development you can outsource, plus the platform work around it
header.description: Hand us an agent, a generative AI application or the platform it runs on. We design, build, harden and operate it, from the first scoping call to production support, with the same discipline we apply to Proxy10x and Ring Promoter.

overview.title: How we work with you
overview.content: Engagements are outcome-led: readiness and strategy when you need clarity, build and automation when you need momentum, and security when the blast radius of getting it wrong is high. You keep ownership of the stack; we bring specialists who have shipped similar work before.

pillars.title: Advise with intent
pillars.description: Assess readiness, choose architectures, and build roadmaps that your board and engineers can both stand behind.

pillars.title: Build and automate
pillars.description: Ship agents, platforms, and pipelines with DevOps and MLOps practices that survive the next release, not just the demo.

pillars.title: Secure the path
pillars.description: Cyber fundamentals through deeper security programmes so AI and API edges are governable in production.
